scope: Untouched 1860 holdout: all 19 complete matched source crops available in the supplied PDF, evaluated with both layouts (38 configurations). Non-random source availability sample, not whole-book accuracy.
selection: Retain all seven pilot tunes per later book. Review both books at preselected printed pages 48, 64, 82, 100, 122, 146, 170, 202, 222, 270, 302, 326, 354, 370, 402, 430, 450 and 470; include every complete matched tune on these pages. Page 430 is prose; include only complete Happy Land on page 354, excluding the preceding Red Sea Anthem continuation. Retain key, clef and repeat differences and every inference outcome. Add the supplied 1860 PDF after visual page mapping: select every available complete match from the same 26 candidates. Unavailable pages are documented and never counted as missing OMR voices. No inference scores were used in selection.
